images.name: cover
images.title: The *AI accounts payable* clerk
images.sub: Bills read, coded, matched and approved on time, with a person releasing every payment.

images.name: quote
images.text: A late reminder is embarrassing. *A payment to the wrong account is usually gone.*

images.name: duties
images.title: Accounts payable, *duty by duty*
rows: Collects bills from the inbox and supplier portals, reads them in, holds likely duplicates.
Codes from supplier history and the chart of accounts. New or unusual bills go on a list.
Checks the bill against the PO and the receipt. Asks the supplier for a credit on a short shipment.
Routes each bill by your limits and follows up when one sits too long.
Answers payment status from the records and reconciles statements each month.
Builds the batch and checks every line. A person releases it in the bank.

images.name: wednesday
images.title: A Wednesday at a *30-person online retailer*
rows: Reads 23 overnight bills, codes them and matches 17 to purchase orders.
A freight bill arrived twice, once as a PDF and once as a link. Holds the copy.
A supplier emails new bank details. Holds their bill for a call to the number on file.
Bill for 40 cases, receiving shows 36. Asks the supplier for a credit note.
Reminds the marketing lead about four bills waiting five days for approval.
Answers two suppliers asking when they'll be paid.
Sends Thursday's payment batch of 31 bills for review and release.

images.name: setup
images.title: How an AI accounts payable clerk *is set up*
steps: The payables inbox, supplier portals, paper mail and automatic charges.
Your chart of accounts, locations or classes, and how billable costs are tagged.
Who approves what amount, and how long a bill can wait before a reminder.
Statements without invoices, changing amounts, forms they need first.
Accounting software, payables inbox, read-only bank feed. No access to move money.
Shadow for two or three weeks
It codes and routes every bill as a draft while a person checks each one.
